title: A nonzero algebra over a field is faithfully flat
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $A$ be a nonzero commutative ring with identity (so $0\ne1$ in $A$), and let $\varphi:k\to A$ be a unital ring homomorphism. Then $A$, as a $k$-module via $c\cdot a=\varphi(c)a$, is faithfully flat; equivalently $\varphi$ is faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map]. No finite-dimensionality, finite-generation, reducedness or domain assumption on $A$ is required.
